name: Click Before Frames
description: Register clicks before each visual frame for lower input delay. / Catat klik sebelum setiap frame visual untuk mengurangi jeda input.

issues.info: Report bugs in English or Bahasa Indonesia / Laporkan bug dalam bahasa Inggris atau Indonesia.

language.name: Language / Bahasa
language.description:
EN: Language used for in-game labels and popups.
ID: Bahasa yang dipakai untuk label dan popup di dalam game.

Settings in the mod menu are written in both languages / Pengaturan di menu mod ditulis dalam dua bahasa.

soft-toggle.name: Disable Mod / Nonaktifkan Mod
soft-toggle.description:
EN: Disable Before Frame without restarting Geometry Dash. This does not disable Physics Bypass if you enabled it!
ID: Nonaktifkan Before Frame tanpa memulai ulang Geometry Dash. Ini TIDAK menonaktifkan Physics Bypass jika sudah diaktifkan!

before-frame.name: Before Frame Mode / Mode Before Frame
before-frame.description:
EN: Pull clicks earlier (before the visual frame) by the configured lead instead of applying them at their exact sub-frame position. Turn this off for classic between-frames precision.
ID: Geser klik lebih awal (sebelum frame visual) sesuai jeda, bukan pada posisi sub-frame persisnya. Matikan untuk presisi klasik di antara frame.

before-frame-lead.name: Pre-Frame Lead (ms) / Jeda Awal (ms)
before-frame-lead.description:
EN: How many milliseconds each click is pulled earlier. 0 = classic precision; 4.17 = one 240 TPS physics step at 60 FPS; 16.67 = one whole 60 FPS frame, which applies every click on the first physics step, before the frame is drawn.
ID: Berapa milidetik klik digeser lebih awal. 0 = presisi klasik; 4,17 = satu step fisika 240 TPS pada 60 FPS; 16,67 = satu frame penuh 60 FPS, sehingga semua klik diterapkan di step fisika pertama sebelum frame digambar.

show-indicator.name: Show Status Label / Tampilkan Label Status
show-indicator.description:
EN: Show a small localized label with the active mode and lead value while playing.
ID: Tampilkan label kecil sesuai bahasa yang dipilih, berisi mode aktif dan nilai jeda saat bermain.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode / Mode Aman
safe-mode.description:
EN: Disable progress and stats on rated levels.
ID: Nonaktifkan progres dan statistik pada level ber-rating.

click-on-steps.name: Click on Steps / Klik per Step
click-on-steps.description:
EN: Only register inputs with 240 TPS precision. Should have identical physics to vanilla.
ID: Hanya catat input dengan presisi 240 TPS. Seharusnya fisikanya sama dengan vanilla.

mouse-fix.name: Reduce Mouse Lag / Kurangi Lag Mouse
mouse-fix.description:
EN: Reduce lag when using high polling rate mice. Experimental, may break things.
ID: Kurangi lag saat memakai mouse dengan polling rate tinggi. Eksperimental, bisa menimbulkan masalah.

precision-fix.name: Precision Fix / Perbaikan Presisi
precision-fix.description:
EN: Improve input precision by preventing framerate desync. Experimental, may break things.
ID: Tingkatkan presisi input dengan mencegah desinkronisasi framerate. Eksperimental, bisa menimbulkan masalah.

physics-bypass.name: Enable Physics Bypass / Aktifkan Physics Bypass
physics-bypass.description:
EN: Reduces stuttering on some FPS values. Active even if "Disable Mod" is checked. THIS WILL ALTER PHYSICS AND MAY BREAK SOME LEVELS! DON'T USE THIS IF YOUR LIST/LEADERBOARD BANS PHYSICS BYPASS!
ID: Mengurangi stutter pada sebagian nilai FPS. Tetap aktif walaupun "Nonaktifkan Mod" dicentang. INI MENGUBAH FISIKA DAN BISA MERUSAK BEBERAPA LEVEL! JANGAN PAKAI JIKA LIST/LEADERBOARD MELARANG PHYSICS BYPASS!

bypass-mode.name: Physics Bypass Mode / Mode Physics Bypass
bypass-mode.description:
EN: 2.2 mode = as few collision checks per frame as possible (minimum 240 checks per second). 2.1 mode = 4 collision checks per frame at 60 FPS or above.
ID: Mode 2.2 = pemeriksaan tabrakan seminimal mungkin per frame (minimal 240 pemeriksaan per detik). Mode 2.1 = 4 pemeriksaan tabrakan per frame pada 60 FPS ke atas.

wine-workaround.name: Wine Workaround / Solusi Wine
wine-workaround.description:
EN: Wine doesn't let you read keyboard input between frames, so this is a workaround. Only disable if you have issues (and don't play with keyboard if you disable it).
ID: Wine tidak mengizinkan input keyboard dibaca di antara frame, jadi ini solusinya. Matikan hanya jika bermasalah (dan jangan main dengan keyboard jika dimatikan).

right-click.name: Right Click P2 / Klik Kanan P2
right-click.description:
EN: Use right click for player 2 jump.
ID: Pakai klik kanan untuk lompatan player 2.
